name: Sebastian Chua Boon Huat Wee-Liang
quote: A freight business is only worth what its promises are worth. We would rather tell a customer at 09:00 that a box has rolled than let them find out at the quay.
bio: Twenty-two years across ocean carriers, forwarding and contract logistics, most of it out of Singapore. Built Paramount's control-tower model after a decade running trade-lane operations between South-East Asia and Northern Europe.
